mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in a 3-month window, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer demand slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline by more than 0.5% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 110), the economy is in an expansion phase that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 110, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), the labor market is tight, leading to wage pressures and potential inflation, which triggers a Fed tightening and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) and the unemployment rate is falling (UNRATE < 3.8%), it signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and UNRATE < 3.8%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
